# CRT-585 — FX_SPOT Smart Checklist (draft)

**Primary focus**: End-to-end verification that the FOREX corner subtype **FX_SPOT** (static list) is defined in IPF, propagated through console/dxCore configuration and WebBroker admin/client surfaces, appears in jobs and EOD reporting, respects account gating (default off), and is tradable on **Adaptive** where the product exposes order entry.

## Primary verification focus

This epic primarily verifies **FX_SPOT** as a new **FOREX** subtype: IPF fields and instrument universe behaviour, platform configuration (supported instruments, m_tree, cash flow, liquidation, short sell, OCO amplitude), WebBroker instrument management and **Forex (FX Spot)** naming, selectors for commissions/risk/books/client widgets, **EOD FX_SPOT** report and **CFD Parameters check** job coverage, and **Adaptive** order entry for FX_SPOT instruments (per epic validation comment).

## IPF and instrument definition

- [CRT-1733] IPF — FOREX instruments used as FX Spot carry **CORNER_SUBTYPE `FX_SPOT`**; conversion-rate FOREX rows keep **empty** `CORNER_SUBTYPE` per requirement table.
> WebBroker rename: **Forex (Conversion Rates) → Forex (FX Spot)** in related WB UI strings (epic description).
- [CRT-1473] IPF — **FOREX** type exposes extended fields for FX_SPOT where required: **Trading Hours**, **CFD Tiered Margin Rates**, **Disable Automatic Margin Rates Update**, **Exposure Limit**, **EPIC** (as listed in epic bullets).
- [CRT-1598] IPF — **OPOL** populated with **`ET`** for FX_SPOT rows where the requirement applies.
- [CRT-1524] IPF — **ROLLOVER_CUT_OFF** present/configurable for FX_SPOT on IPF storage.
> ! reason: `snippet_text` missing in epic-ref (`macro_shape_unsupported`); verify against live IPF export / BA-approved cut-off examples (e.g. NZD vs others) per team TCs.
- [CRT-1474] IPF — **OCO min amplitude** field available for FX_SPOT and **not cleared** on IPF update (decimal display behaviour per snippet).
- [CRT-1731] IPF — **EPIC** on FX_SPOT sourced from **IG-related CFD_FOREX** mapping (margin rates path tied to EPIC field).
- [CRT-1734] IPF — **Subtype / instrument type** logic for FOREX vs FX_SPOT matches Confluence **CRT-1734** (instrument type definition).
> ! reason: `page_id_unresolved` / snippet absent in epic-ref; confirm effective subtype filter (e.g. IPF `EFFECTIVE_SUBTYPE=FX_SPOT`) matches implemented rule set.
- [CRT-101] Instrument universe / IPF sync — **FOREX instruments are not mutated** by IPF synchronization when FX_SPOT static list jobs run (no unintended updates to non-target FOREX rows).
> ! reason: `snippet_text` missing in epic-ref; execute DB/list diff around job per team procedure.
- [CRT-1480] Static list — **FX_SPOT** instruments created from uploaded static list; **lot size, quantity increment, multiplier** copied from the **relevant CFD FOREX DMA** pair as epic states.

## Trading hours, margin IG, routing (non-routing config only)

- [CRT-1481] Trading hours — **FX_SPOT** trading hours configurable and visible where platform exposes FOREX hours.
> ! reason: `page_id_unresolved` in epic-ref; validate against console/IPF surfaces referenced in validation blockers (e.g. XT-7202 class issues) without inventing field names.
- [CRT-1522] Margin — **Margin rates from IG** files respected for FX_SPOT, **matched by EPIC** mapping.
> ! reason: `page_id_unresolved` in epic-ref; use real IG fixture + job output when executing (see validation comment placeholders vs production file behaviour).

## Console / dxCore configuration (non-routing)

- [CRT-1527] Console — **FX_SPOT** appears in **supported instruments** / allowed-type configuration for accounts as requirement describes.
- [CRT-1529] Console — **Instrument tree (m_tree)** shows **FOREX** with **FX_SPOT** subtype where applicable.
- [CRT-1528] Console — **Cash flow mapping** includes **FOREX (FX_SPOT subtype)** path per configuration table.
- [CRT-1530] Console — **Liquidation / leveraged instrument types** configuration includes **FOREX (FX_SPOT subtype)** row.
- [CRT-1526] Console — **Short sell allowed instruments** can include **FOREX (FX_SPOT subtype)** where product allows.
- [CRT-1531] Console — **OCO min amplitude** can be configured per type including FX_SPOT row in `oco_min_amplitude_percent_per_type` (or equivalent).
> ! reason: `snippet_text` empty in epic-ref (`macro_shape_unsupported`); confirm command/UI parity with CFD types.

## WebBroker — instruments and admin

- [CRT-1733] WebBroker — **Instrument type list** shows **FOREX** with updated labelling (**Forex (FX Spot)**) instead of legacy conversion-rates naming where epic applies.
- [CRT-1733] WebBroker — **Cornertrader Subtype** column: **FX_SPOT** for spot instruments; **empty** for conversion-rate FOREX instruments.
- [CRT-1733] WebBroker — **CRUD + export** flows for a representative **FX_SPOT** symbol (create, edit, copy uniqueness, close, export CSV field set) match IPF-backed attributes.
> Import-from-CSV scenarios: track against linked defects in epic validation (e.g. XT-7496) — do not treat as green without retest note.

## WebBroker — commissions, risk, order/position books, backup prices

- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Commissions**: **FOREX** instrument type visible in commission plan configuration; plans can target **FOREX** / FX_SPOT-eligible instruments per admin UX.
- [CRT-1473] WebBroker — **Risk settings**: **exposure limit** can be set for FX_SPOT where FOREX tiered margin / exposure fields apply (align with IPF).
> Instrument-type naming in risk selectors: reconcile with validation blockers (e.g. XT-7520) during retest.
- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Order book**: **Instrument type** column shows **FOREX** for FX_SPOT symbols; **Instrument type** filter includes **FOREX**; **Symbol** filter finds FX_SPOT symbols.
> OPOL filter **ET**: track XT-7471 retest — executable only when fix verified.
- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Position book**: same **Instrument type** / **FOREX** filter expectations; **Symbol** filter for FX_SPOT does not loop or hang.
> Track XT-7470 retest for symbol filter stability.
- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Backup prices**: can select **FX_SPOT** symbol, change BP, add new BP row.
- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Financing/Swaps**: financing configuration does **not** apply incorrectly to **FX_SPOT** positions (epic description intent).

## WebBroker — client area widgets

- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Account transactions / positions / orders / trades / trading journal**: filters allow **FOREX** type and/or **FX_SPOT** symbol as described (symbol vs type filters per surface).
- [CRT-585] WebBroker — **Watchlist / chart**: can add **FX_SPOT** instrument; chart receives data for that symbol.

## Account gating

- [CRT-1533] WebBroker — **FX_SPOT disabled by default** on existing client accounts; can be **enabled** where product allows instrument on account.
> ! reason: `page_id_unresolved` in epic-ref; use account instrument-availability UI/API checks aligned with QA TCs.

## Reporting and jobs

- [CRT-1534] EOD — **EOD Instruments FX_SPOT** report: file naming pattern **`YYYY.MM.DD_HH.MM.SS_FX_SPOT.csv`** (timezone per project); each run produces new file; fields include **`instrument_type`** etc. per requirement snippet.
> Historic report scope: snippet states not supported here — confirm single-run behaviour only.
> Track XT-7181 retest for report creation defect.
- [CRT-1732] Jobs — **CFD Parameters check** job **includes FX_SPOT** instruments in its parameter scan scope; **job log messages** mention FX_SPOT outcomes when instruments are present.
> ! reason: `snippet_text` missing (`macro_shape_unsupported`); align log expectations with XT-7493 / XT-7582 validation items on retest.

## Adaptive

- [CRT-585] Adaptive — **Order entry** can submit and manage orders for **FX_SPOT** instruments on the Adaptive trading path (epic validation lists **CAN-12469** as blocker until fixed).
> Treat as **primary** surface because `client_shell_impact.adaptive` is **affected**; if still blocked, capture build under defect retest, not as silent pass.

## Explicitly out of scope (epic text)

- **Routing-related** configuration rows called out as excluded in epic (“all except routing related”) — do not expand checklist into full routing matrix unless a linked defect explicitly requires it.
- **Upstream XT** generic “conversion-rate FOREX only” demos — background contrast only; not Corner FX_SPOT deliverable proof.
